help:
Click a file or press i to type. Esc returns to navigation.

Ctrl S  Save file
Ctrl Q  Quit safely
Ctrl P  Find project file
Ctrl F  Search current file
F2  Project explorer
F3  Search project
F4  Editor settings

Space shows commands. :Settings opens editor settings. Configuration files use Lua; plugins and extra features use native LazyVim menus. Press q or Esc to close.
title: OS editor help
